title: Wall Street Is Doing Something Insane…. ($71 Trillion)
speaker: Tom & Mike (StockedUp hosts)

macro_themes.view: Midterm-year and first-five-days-of-October seasonality favour the bulls.
Wall Street acting like the US has won Hormuz despite continuing tanker attacks; diesel above $6, refined-fuel shortage benefits refiners.
NVDA, AAPL, MSFT over 21% of the S&P 500, record concentration, but tech leadership keeps the market rising.
S&P PEG ratio at a 30-year low; market may not be as expensive as it looks.

calls.condition: Breakout above all-time high 781.62 → push higher; pullback under 778-779 → consolidation.
calls.reason: New all-time high, strong October/midterm seasonality.
calls.quote: If we could see a clear breakout past that, I think the spy could start to push higher.

calls.condition: If 378-380 support holds, watch for break above recent highs.
calls.reason: Holding support, pushing toward recent highs, should follow a rising market.
calls.quote: I would not be surprised if Tesla continued to move higher and follow the market up in the immediate short term.

calls.condition: If 170-171 support holds, watch for recovery.
calls.reason: Strong three days, momentum high; intraday pullback to support.
calls.quote: I still think that there could be a lot of potential going into this week and even next week as well.

calls.condition: Hold $300 and retest 308 = bullish; wait if selling continues.
calls.reason: Google $4.3B 20-year nuclear PPA; popped 12% and broke its downtrend; AI electricity demand.
calls.quote: I still like the riskreward playing this one in an upside sense especially in a broader sense.

calls.condition: If it breaks above 290, watch for another uptrend.
calls.reason: Recovering as oil eases and Hormuz exports improve; Silversea voyage news.
calls.quote: if it's able to break above 290 tomorrow, watch for another good uptrend to take place

calls.instrument_quoted: CRAK (refiners ETF; also XLE, VLO, MPC, PSX, DINO)
calls.reason: Refined-fuel (diesel/gasoline) shortage; refiners pushing to new highs even as crude dips.
calls.quote: these individual refining companies like VLOO continue to push up to new recent highs. I will be watching them closely

calls.reason: Momentum play, nuclear sympathy with CEG.
calls.quote: If Oak ends up breaking out about $39.30, watch it to the upside.

calls.reason: Momentum play; kept marching to new highs.
calls.quote: AMD kept marching to new highs today. If it breaks out above $65,855, keep watching it up.
If CRM ends up breaking down under $22.80, watch for the downtrend to continue into tomorrow.

calls.instrument_quoted: TIC (10/12.5 call debit spread, big-money flow)
calls.reason: $1M call debit spread; higher lows, sympathy with data-infrastructure/CEG move; fakeout risk in broader downtrend.
calls.quote: we could see a pretty good push up to there if we do get past this $10.50 zone

notes: Date: host says 'today is the fourth trading day of October' and FOMC minutes 'tomorrow' → Tuesday 2026-10-06 (listing said 10-07).
